title: Chapter 16 Identity Card
content:
Chapter 16 Identity Card

After the recruitment order was issued, Wu Qing had no one around him except Hu Tu.

He asked Hu Tu to find a few people to help, set up a table at the gate of the castle, and hung a sign of the Talent Recruitment Hall. The Talent Recruitment Hall was open.

When the residents of the territory saw this scene, many people came to see the strangeness, but no one dared to come up to register for the time being.

Wu Qing did not come out. This world is different. He does not need to show his closeness to the people in person. There is no need for this.

Everything is left to Hu Tu. Wu Qing also wants to see his performance.

Hu Tu stood behind the table, watching a bunch of people outside the castle watching the excitement, and was somewhat helpless.

The scene was deadlocked.

After a while, more and more residents gathered around. Things happened one after another today, and even the lord was changed. Everyone was at a loss for a while, and they all put down their things and waited and watched.

As a fox, Hu Tu was still a bit smart. He saw an acquaintance standing in front of the crowd, and he had an idea and shouted in that direction.

"Grandpa Goat! Your skills in managing fields are unmatched. Everyone always asks you for advice. Why don't you come and register first!"

The Grandpa Goat mentioned by Hu Tu is an old man of the sheep tribe with two goat horns and a tuft of white goat beard. He has dark skin and looks very tough.

Wu Qing watched this scene through the host.

"In this world, the lord has a dog head, while the lower-class people have evolved more completely. It's really strange."

Many things in this world are not in line with Wu Qing's cognition, and he needs to adapt slowly.

Being named by Hu Tu, who represented the lord, the old man of the sheep tribe could only walk forward and said helplessly: "Little Hu Tu, can I enter this recruitment hall with my farming tricks?"

"Of course, come and register!"

Hu Tu finally forced someone to register, which was considered a start.

...

At this time, Wu Qing was discussing with the Queen of Zerg to use the Zerg technology to create a biological tool to assist local creatures in work and study.

Wu Qing provided ideas, and the Queen of Zerg designed a plan. They soon decided on the manufacturing plan for the biological tool named identity card.

In the mother nest of the Zerg territory, a larva opened the genetic code of the identity card and turned into a pupa.

After a while, the pupa cracked open, and 50 black cards with beautiful shapes and the size of a baby's palm were manufactured.

The manufacture of this identity card requires 10 energy points and 1 gas point per piece. Each larva can manufacture up to 100 cards, and 100 cards occupy a population limit of the Zerg.

Identity cards, like biological colonization suits, are Zerg creatures with instinctive consciousness. After other local creatures are bound to identity cards, Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg can use them to convey orders, guide work and study at the consciousness level.

In this way, local creatures are like puppets on the front desk. They just need to do everything as required, and they don't need to have much talent.

Of course, those talented and motivated local creatures can learn through identity cards and become independent talents.

It can be said that identity cards are also Wu Qing's talent training tools.

A host flew over, rolled up 50 identity cards, and flew towards Daxia Territory.

…

In the simple recruitment hall in front of the castle of the Lord of Daxia Territory, the old man of the sheep tribe that Hu Tu took the initiative to pull over just answered a few simple questions and passed the assessment, becoming the first lord's subordinate to be recruited through the recruitment hall.

With someone taking the lead, and Hu Tu's constant shouting, someone finally took the initiative to come and register.

The situation finally opened up.

Until noon, Hu Tu registered and assessed a total of 20 people, most of whom were young people from various tribes.

Without exception, these people passed the assessment.

Most of these people were familiar with certain aspects of work like the old man of the sheep tribe, and there were also a few warlike young people who said they were good at fighting and wanted to join the army.

There was no one who dared to say that he had some management skills.

This result was within Wu Qing's expectations. Now those who stayed in the territory were all low-level people. Those who were truly capable had already seen the situation and ran away.

In this situation, Wu Qing plans to use Hu Tu first, train him briefly, and let him follow his example to manage a small territory. There should be no problem.

The identity cards were delivered, and Wu Qing asked Hu Tu to give each of the first batch of local creatures one.

The blood is bound to the identity card, and the main registration information such as personal name and specialty is displayed on the exquisite identity card. The information on the card can be updated at any time to show the identity.

With the identity card, you can receive information in real time at the consciousness level, and the identity cards can also communicate with each other, which is equivalent to allowing local creatures to access the Zerg information network in another way, a network strictly controlled by the Queen.

The identity card can also become a temporary amulet to resist damage in times of crisis.

The local creatures who get the identity card have a chance to change their own destiny.

At lunch time, no one eats. At this time, there is a shortage of food, and the grain in the fields outside the city has not been harvested yet. Every household has no surplus food, and can only eat breakfast and dinner every day to barely survive.

Wu Qing had just taken over the territory, and many things had to be done step by step.

A city with such a small population was still ruled by absolute authority, so there wouldn't be too many things to do.

Next, Wu Qing dispersed the crowd through the host, and everyone continued to do what they were supposed to do.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

The crowd gradually dispersed.

After Wu Qing told the Queen of the Insects about the general direction of the development of the Great Xia Territory, all the details would be handed over to the Queen of the Insects to deal with.

The Queen of the Insects will become stronger and stronger with the development of the Zerg. With more things she is exposed to, her knowledge will become wider and wider, and she will be able to keep up with the speed of the development of the Great Xia Territory.

The twenty native creatures on standby in the lord's castle will become the first batch of chess pieces in the hands of the Queen of the Insects to play the big chess game of the Great Xia Territory.

In terms of the development of the Zerg territory, since there is no war today, the system's energy resources are all collected by worker bees. The air resources have increased a little because Wu Qing has become the lord and the Zerg has entered the world of native creatures.

If necessary, the luck of the Great Xia Territory can be converted into the air resources of the Zerg, and the air resources of the Zerg can also be converted into the luck of the Great Xia Territory, which can play a huge role in an emergency.

Now the luck of the Great Xia Territory is just enough to protect itself, and the Zerg does not need to draw the air from the territory to increase its troops.

As the sky gradually darkened, Wu Qing was not going back to the Zerg territory today. He wanted to test the weirdness in Daxia Territory.

A large number of hosts flew from the Zerg territory and flew over Daxia Territory, blocking the afterglow of the setting sun.

The people working outside the city were rushing back to the city quickly. Whenever night fell, it was not safe outside the city.

Hu Tu was already a lonely man in the city, with only some people of the same clan, but no close relatives.

Wu Qing let him live in the castle.

It was also the first time that Wu Qing ate the food of this world. It was very simple and could only be used to fill his stomach.

At night, Wu Qing stood alone at the highest point of the castle, looking at the few lights in the city, waiting for the arrival of the weirdness.

This time, Wu Qing was disappointed. The weirdness that had been haunting him for the past two days did not appear.

"This lord's authority is the product of the world's rules, and it is indeed powerful."

"No matter how weird something is, it cannot break through the restrictions of the world's rules."

"Is it just like this tonight? If I don't make some extra money, I feel like I'm losing money!"
